scope: Existing published DaLiA/WildPPG HR linear outputs only; missing runs remain missing
checks: manifest source file sizes and modification times unchanged
fixed upstream subject splits independently reproduced
no train/test overlap; complete folds cover each subject once per seed
ordered prediction subjects and labels match finite-label source rows
finite predictions and recomputed window HR MAE
canonical cached features have finite values and expected dimensions
limitations: Only published linear results were audited; absence is not a measured failure.
Processed DaLiA excludes windows according to upstream preprocessing; this is not all raw motion data.
Repeated overlapping windows and seeds are not independent subjects; no population CI is claimed here.
The original inner CV implementation was not rerun; outer splits and saved artifacts were checked.
Original run dataset fingerprints use size and mtime, not waveform content hashes. Canonical feature export hashes are included.
